query:
SELECT title, similarity(title, 'ojfpnfk edkiinnjx') AS sim
FROM tg_t
WHERE title % 'ojfpnfk edkiinnjx'
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 5;

setup.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm; SELECT setseed(0.17); CREATE TABLE tg_t AS WITH v AS (SELECT array_agg(translate(substr(md5(n::text), 1, 5 + (n % 5)), '0123456789', 'ghijklmnop') ORDER BY n) AS vocab FROM generate_series(1, 2000) n) SELECT i AS id, vocab[1 + floor(2000 * power(random(), 2))::int] || ' ' || vocab[1 + floor(2000 * power(random(), 2))::int] || ' ' || vocab[1 + floor(2000 * power(random(), 2))::int] AS title FROM generate_series(1, 1000000) i, v; ALTER TABLE tg_t ADD PRIMARY KEY (id); ALTER TABLE tg_t SET (autovacuum_enabled = false); VACUUM ANALYZE tg_t;
CREATE INDEX tg_gin ON tg_t USING gin (title gin_trgm_ops); ANALYZE tg_t;
